environment.cpu: Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H, 22 logical cores, 31.4 GB
environment.infrastructureProfile: developer laptop; API, worker, Postgres, Redis and the k6 container all on one machine
environment.mix: contact list 52%, search 12%, get 15%, inbox list 8%, inbox counts 4%, create 4%, update 2%, /health 3% (control, no tenant work)
environment.rates: normal 5 req/s, peak 20 req/s, spike 5 to 60 req/s (3x peak), soak 5 req/s; open model (arrival rate)

comparabilityWarning: Valid only against runs from this same machine and Node version. The rates are chosen, not taken from production traffic. The soak is minutes, not hours.
